name: Camera Resolution
description: The resolution of the camera can affect the processing time of the onboard classifier, as higher resolutions require more processing power.

name: Onboard Computation Power
description: The processing power of the onboard computer can affect the time it takes to analyze an image, as more powerful computers can process images faster.

name: Operating System
description: The operating system used on the onboard computer can affect the processing time of the onboard classifier, as different OS's can have different overheads and inefficiencies.

name: Network Bandwidth
description: The bandwidth of the network used to transmit images to the human operator can affect the time it takes to analyze an image, as slower networks can increase the time it takes to transmit images.

name: Human Operator Location
description: The location of the human operator can affect the time it takes to analyze an image, as images may need to be transmitted over longer distances to reach the operator.

name: Data Transfer Protocol
description: The protocol used to transfer images to the human operator can affect the time it takes to analyze an image, as different protocols can have different overheads and inefficiencies.

name: Weather Conditions
description: Weather conditions such as fog, haze, or high winds can affect the quality of the images taken by the UAV, leading to longer processing times.

name: Lighting Conditions
description: The lighting conditions at the waypoint can affect the quality of the images taken by the UAV, leading to longer processing times.

name: UAV Speed
description: The speed of the UAV can affect the time it takes to reach the next waypoint, leading to longer processing times if the UAV is moving slowly.

name: Image Size
description: The size of the image can affect the processing time of the onboard classifier, as larger images require more processing power.

name: Battery Life
description: The battery life of the UAV can affect the time it can spend at each waypoint, leading to longer processing times if the battery runs out.

name: Sensor Quality
description: The quality of the sensors used on the UAV can affect the quality of the images taken, leading to longer processing times.

name: Human Operator Experience
description: The experience of the human operator can affect the time it takes to analyze an image, as more experienced operators may be able to analyze images faster.

name: UAV Maintenance
description: The maintenance history of the UAV can affect the performance of the onboard computer and sensors, leading to longer processing times.

name: Software Updates
description: The software updates applied to the onboard computer and classifier can affect the processing time of the onboard classifier, as newer software may be more efficient.
